data.description: 她的房间，台灯下摊着精密模型套件与镊子，她戴着细框眼镜用魔术微雕零件；完成一处的满足感，是她少数不设防的快乐。

data.promptProse: Under the desk lamp, Medea positions a tiny scale-model part with fine tweezers, smiling slightly when it fits exactly. Fine-framed glasses sit before blue eyes above her pale-blue long-sleeved blouse and dark skirt. The medium view includes paint jars and a magnifier around the padded mat, room surfaces behind. Warm task light catches the tweezers and pointed ear, casting precise miniature shadows across the model and darker shade beneath the magnifier.
